senses.gloss: f. (preced.) shrivelled surface, scar (= b. h. צָרֶבֶת).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 7:1">Neg. VII, 1</cite> <he>עד שלא נעשו צ׳</he> ed. Dehr. (ed. <cite ref="R00734"><he>צרבת</he></cite>) before they are cicatrized; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:14">Tosef. ib. II, 14</cite> <he>צורבה</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:26">Lam. R. to I, 2</cite> [read:] <he>ונושכות על לחייהם כצרבת השחין</he> and they (the tears) ate themselves into their cheeks (forming a surface) like the scars of a sore.
